paragraphs.source_en: When Hideyoshi rose, his face was utterly bloodless as he drank the tea a servant handed him. As he drank, he recalled the words Rikyū had spoken before his death. paragraphs.source_en: Naturally, none of these rumors reached Hideyoshi’s ears. After reaching Arima, Hideyoshi still alternated between weeping and falling silent, only to begin weeping again. To the eyes of the world, the blow dealt to Hideyoshi by Tsurumatsu’s early death had pierced him to the very marrow.
